name: D2PeriodType
title: DHIS2 period type
description: The DHIS2 period type an aggregate form is reported under - the reporting frequency of the data set the Questionnaire was generated from. A response to the form states one period of this type on D2Period, so a client knows which ISO period format the instance accepts before it builds one. Only an aggregate form declares it, because only a data set has a reporting frequency.
